title: Vector Distinguished Postdoctoral Fellowship
about: Postdoctoral fellowship at the Vector Institute with two application cohorts per year. The Hiring Committee reviews applications in March and September; applications arriving after a deadline are added to the next cohort.
requirements: Single PDF with cover letter, CV, publications, research statement and three reference letters

upskill.name: Deep Learning & Neural Architectures I
why: "Machine learning and deep learning" (field) → "Transformer architecture (2017): self-attention; backbone of all modern LLMs and vision models"
"Machine learning and deep learning" (field) → "Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs): image recognition, object detection, segmentation"
